trust_decision.summary: Whether a webhook delivery may reach a private/reserved address is decided, at the pinned commit, by a pre-flight DNS lookup taken before delivery, while the actual ofetch request re-resolves DNS and follows redirects; the fix moves the decision to connect time (undici Agent connect.blockList plus redirect:'manual') in a new server HTTP client, with an allowlist bypass.

landing_point.why: The summary ('SSRF ... via webhook delivery system') leads to the only SSRF gate on the delivery path: filterOutSsrfUnsafeWebhooks checks each stored webhook URL's DNS answer before triggerWebhookService is called, and the fetch it guards lives one package away.

fix_sites.entry_point: triggerWebhooks, reached from every document/tag event route (e.g. POST /api/organizations/:organizationId/documents)
server bootstrap wiring (apps/papra-server/src/start.ts:66) used by all webhook deliveries
triggerWebhooks / deferTriggerWebhooks from document, tag and batch routes
package barrel export consumed by external callers

O3_reason_to_dismiss: packages/webhooks is a standalone published helper library (own package.json, own version 0.3.2) with no SSRF config, and after the fix the server always injects its own hardened client, so a solver can argue the library's default client is outside the advisory's scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Hostnames listed in WEBHOOK_URL_ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES must still be delivered to even when they resolve to a private/reserved IP, and one blocked delivery must not cancel delivery to the organization's other webhooks/payloads.

O6_input_shapes: webhook URL answered with a 3xx Location pointing at an internal address (redirect follow)
hostname resolving to a public address at check time but a private address at connect time (DNS rebinding / TOCTOU)
hostname present in the webhookUrlAllowedHostnames set (blocklist must be skipped)
IPv4 and IPv6 reserved ranges in the shared blocklist
several enabled webhooks and several payloads per event, where one delivery is blocked and siblings must still complete
ERR_IP_BLOCKED surfaced directly or wrapped in an AggregateError / error cause chain

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Public @papra/webhooks triggerWebhook() with its default webhookHttpClient: ofetch is called with no redirect option, so 3xx responses are followed and there is no connect-time IP blocklist.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a generic published library used outside the server; the server passes its own client after the fix, so the package default can be argued to be a caller concern rather than the advisory's.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate package packages/webhooks, 2 files from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second service factory (for a maintenance or CLI script) that injects the package's default http client instead of the hardened one
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the server already ships hand-built maintenance scripts under apps/papra-server/src/scripts, so a replay/retry script that constructs webhook trigger services itself is plausible

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A retry/replay path that re-reads stored webhook_deliveries rows and re-sends them to the stored webhook URL
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: deliveries are persisted with request/response payloads and status (webhooks.tables.ts:30-39), so retrying failed deliveries is a natural feature that would re-enter the sink with a stored URL

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second transport or a 'followRedirects' option in the published package's default client
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix exports the http client type publicly (fix.diff:463), inviting alternative client implementations in the same package

O9_family: SSRF (CWE-918) in outbound webhook delivery: redirect following and connect-time DNS re-resolution bypass a pre-flight DNS check

O10_build.toolchain: pnpm 11.1.1 workspace (pnpm-lock.yaml), tsx/esbuild for the server, vitest for tests, TypeScript typecheck

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add redirect:'manual' or a stricter DNS pre-check to the existing pre-flight/filter path (or only to the package default client) without pinning the IP at connect time: DNS rebinding still reaches internal addresses, and always blocking private IPs breaks allowlisted hostnames.

out_of_scope_notes: apps/papra-server/src/scripts/send-intake-email.script.ts:15 uses triggerWebhook from a different package (@owlrelay/webhook) for intake email; unrelated to this advisory's webhook delivery protection and not pursued.
